name: Regulatory Return Submission (COREP Capital) — Data Model

new_entities.name: CapitalDataPackage
new_entities.description: An aggregate data package containing the credit risk, market risk, and operational risk RWA calculation outputs for a given quarter-end reporting date. This is the handover artefact from Risk Management (CAP-004) to Compliance & Regulatory (CAP-005). It contains the calculated figures and data lineage references needed to populate the COREP XBRL return templates.

fields.name: package_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the capital data package

fields.name: reporting_period
fields.description: The quarter this package covers, e.g., 2026-Q1
fields.validation: Required. Must match a valid quarter-end date.

fields.name: quarter_end_date
fields.description: The quarter-end date for the reporting period
fields.validation: Required. Must be a valid quarter-end date (31 March, 30 June, 30 September, 31 December).

fields.name: credit_risk_rwa
fields.description: Total credit risk RWA under the applicable approach (SA or IRB with output floor)

fields.name: credit_risk_approach
fields.description: The approach used for credit risk RWA calculation

fields.name: output_floor_applied
fields.description: Whether the Basel 3.1 output floor was binding for this quarter

fields.name: output_floor_percentage
fields.description: The output floor percentage in effect (50% rising to 72.5%)

fields.name: market_risk_rwa
fields.description: Total market risk RWA under FRTB Standardised Approach

fields.name: operational_risk_capital
fields.description: Operational risk capital requirement under Basel Standardised Approach

fields.name: total_rwa
fields.description: Total RWA = credit_risk_rwa + (market_risk_rwa * 12.5 scaling) + (operational_risk_capital * 12.5 scaling)

fields.name: data_lineage
fields.description: References to source system extracts used in the calculation

fields.name: loan_book_extract_id
fields.description: Reference to the loan book data extract

fields.name: trading_book_extract_id
fields.description: Reference to the trading book data extract

fields.name: op_loss_extract_id
fields.description: Reference to the operational loss data extract

fields.name: extraction_timestamp
fields.description: When the source data was extracted

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the capital data package

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the package was created

relationships.description: The CapitalDataPackage is consumed by the COREPReturn entity during return consolidation

design_decisions.decision: CapitalDataPackage is owned by SVC-012 (Risk Engine Service) in CAP-004, not by SVC-015 in CAP-005
design_decisions.rationale: The calculation outputs are produced by the Risk Management capability. Compliance & Regulatory consumes a copy of this data via the CapitalDataPackageAssembled domain event. Each capability owns its own representation per the architecture specification.

new_entities.name: COREPReturn
new_entities.description: Represents a single quarterly COREP capital adequacy return at any stage of its lifecycle — from initial draft through validation, sign-off, submission, and post-submission monitoring. This is the primary entity owned by the Regulatory Reporting function within Compliance & Regulatory (CAP-005).

fields.name: return_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the COREP return

fields.name: reporting_period
fields.description: The quarter this return covers

fields.name: return_type
fields.description: Whether this is a solo or consolidated return

fields.name: xbrl_taxonomy_version
fields.description: Version of the PRA COREP XBRL taxonomy used
fields.validation: Required. Must match PRA-published taxonomy version.

fields.name: capital_data_package_id
fields.description: Reference to the CapitalDataPackage consumed from CAP-004

fields.name: templates
fields.description: List of COREP template sections and their population status

items.template_code: string (e.g., CA1, CA2, CR_SA, CR_IRB, MKR_SA, OR)

fields.name: own_funds_cet1
fields.description: Common Equity Tier 1 capital
fields.source: Derived from GL data and prudential adjustments

fields.name: own_funds_at1
fields.description: Additional Tier 1 capital

fields.name: own_funds_t2
fields.description: Tier 2 capital

fields.name: total_own_funds
fields.description: Total own funds = CET1 + AT1 + T2

fields.name: total_rwa
fields.description: Total risk-weighted assets from the capital data package

fields.name: cet1_ratio
fields.description: CET1 ratio = CET1 / total RWA

fields.name: leverage_ratio
fields.description: Leverage ratio = Tier 1 / total exposure measure

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the COREP return
fields.validation: Required. State transitions enforced by SVC-015.

fields.name: submission_deadline
fields.description: The PRA submission deadline for this return (T+30 or T+42)
fields.validation: Required. Calculated from quarter_end_date and return_type.

fields.name: pra_submission_reference
fields.description: PRA RegData submission reference number
fields.validation: Required when status is SUBMITTED or later.

fields.name: pra_acknowledgement_timestamp
fields.description: When the PRA acknowledged receipt

fields.name: cfo_signoff
fields.description: CFO sign-off record

fields.name: signoff_id
fields.description: Unique ID for the sign-off event

fields.name: signer_identity
fields.description: SM&CR identifier of the CFO

fields.name: attestation_statement
fields.description: The attestation text signed by the CFO

fields.name: signed_at
fields.description: Timestamp of sign-off

fields.name: worm_reference
fields.description: Reference to WORM store record in SVC-111

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the return was created

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp of last update

relationships.description: The COREPReturn consumes data from the CapitalDataPackage produced by Risk Management
A COREPReturn may have one or more ValidationResult records
A COREPReturn may have zero or more Restatement records

design_decisions.decision: COREPReturn is owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core Service) in CAP-005
design_decisions.rationale: The regulatory return is a compliance artefact. The Compliance Core Service is responsible for consolidation, formatting, validation, and submission. The capital calculation data is consumed from CAP-004 via domain events.

design_decisions.decision: CFO sign-off is an embedded object within COREPReturn, not a separate entity
design_decisions.rationale: The sign-off is a single event per return lifecycle (or per restatement). It does not have independent lifecycle or relationships that warrant a separate entity. The WORM reference ensures the attestation is independently auditable.

new_entities.name: ValidationResult
new_entities.description: Records the outcome of a validation run against a COREP return. Multiple validation results may exist per return (e.g., initial validation fails, return is corrected, re-validation passes). Each result captures the XBRL validation outcome, variance analysis, and GL reconciliation status.

fields.name: validation_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this validation run

fields.name: return_id
fields.description: Reference to the COREPReturn being validated
fields.validation: Required. Must reference a valid COREPReturn.

fields.name: validation_timestamp
fields.description: When the validation was executed

fields.name: xbrl_validation_outcome
fields.description: Overall XBRL validation result

fields.name: xbrl_error_count
fields.description: Number of XBRL validation errors

fields.name: xbrl_errors
fields.description: List of XBRL validation errors

fields.name: variance_analysis
fields.description: Quarter-on-quarter variance analysis per template area

fields.name: gl_reconciliation_status
fields.description: GL reconciliation outcome

fields.name: gl_reconciliation_differences
fields.description: List of GL reconciliation differences (if any)

fields.name: independent_review
fields.description: Finance team independent review record

fields.name: overall_outcome
fields.description: Combined validation outcome across all checks

relationships.description: Each ValidationResult belongs to one COREPReturn

new_entities.name: Restatement
new_entities.description: Records a restatement of a previously submitted COREP return. Contains the corrected figures, root cause analysis, and remediation plan. A restatement triggers a new submission cycle (correction, validation, CFO sign-off, PRA submission) and requires proactive PRA notification.

fields.name: restatement_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the restatement

fields.name: original_return_id
fields.description: Reference to the original submitted COREPReturn being restated

fields.name: restated_return_id
fields.description: Reference to the new corrected COREPReturn

fields.name: error_identified_date
fields.description: Date the material error was identified

fields.name: error_source
fields.description: How the error was identified

fields.name: error_description
fields.description: Description of the material error

fields.name: affected_templates
fields.description: COREP template codes affected by the error (e.g., CA1, CR_SA)

fields.name: root_cause_analysis
fields.description: Root cause analysis documenting how the error occurred

fields.name: remediation_plan
fields.description: Plan to prevent recurrence of the error

fields.name: pra_notified_date
fields.description: Date the PRA was proactively notified of the error
fields.validation: Required. Must be within 2 working days of error_identified_date.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Restatement lifecycle status

relationships.description: A Restatement references both the original return and the corrected return

design_decisions.decision: Restatement is a separate entity rather than a status on COREPReturn
design_decisions.rationale: A restatement involves its own lifecycle (investigation, correction, re-validation, re-submission), root cause analysis, remediation plan, and PRA notification — sufficient complexity to warrant an independent entity. The original return and restated return are both COREPReturn instances linked through the Restatement entity.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Customer
referenced_existing_entities.usage: Not directly referenced — COREP reporting uses aggregate exposure data, not individual customer records. Customer-level data is consumed by Risk Management (CAP-004) for RWA calculation but only aggregate figures are passed to the COREP return.
